- one retry after a timeout without an ID tag

## Requirements
### C-1: Checkout retries
A payment that times out is retried once, never twice. [src/checkout/retry.ts:1-10](src/checkout/retry.ts#L1-L10)

### C-4: Checkout audit log
Every retry writes an audit entry in the same checkout folder. [src/checkout/audit.ts:1-8](src/checkout/audit.ts#L1-L8)
